svg.title: Employee profiles: title, department, manager, location, start date — SoftTrack web design mockup (#122)
svg.desc: Settings → Profile gains job title and location, which the person edits, and a read-only block for department, manager and start date, which a site admin sets from Administration → Users.

svg.text: Columns on the profile model in lib_identity: job_title, location, started_on, plus department_id (#123) and manager_id (#124), which ship with their tables. The profile response
and the admin user endpoints carry them; openapi.json and the Orval client are regenerated.
